source: I added cursor-based pagination to the invoice list in the ledgerlark project. The new code lives in src/billing/list_invoices.py and the route in src/api/invoices.py now accepts a limit parameter, capped at 100. I also updated the OpenAPI file docs/openapi.yaml so the cursor field is documented. I ran the whole suite: 48 tests passed and none failed. Old clients that send no limit still get the first 25 rows, so nothing breaks for them. Nothing else is outstanding on this task.
